visual.caption: SMB 列舉｜連線成功，不等於取得檔案權限
visual.description: 把一次連線拆成五個關卡；每成功一個階段，只能確認該階段的結果；被拒絕時，先查發生在哪個階段。看見共用名稱 ≠ 能進入；讀到某個檔案 ≠ 有權修改或刪除。

items.title: Transport｜建立網路連線
items.body:
✓ TCP 445 可達
× 不代表列出共用

items.title: Negotiate｜協商協定
items.body:
✓ SMB 版本、能力
× 不代表身分通過

items.title: Session Setup｜建立身分工作階段
items.body:
✓ 確認實際使用身分
× 不代表可進所有共用

items.title: Tree Connect｜連接指定共用
items.body:
✓ 例如 Training 可進入
× 不代表能讀所有檔案

items.title: File Operation｜操作檔案／目錄
items.body:
✓ 列出、讀取、寫入等
× 各操作須分別驗證

visual.caption: SMB enumeration｜A connection does not establish file permissions
visual.description: Treat a connection as five checkpoints. Each successful stage establishes only its own result. Locate the failed stage before diagnosing a refusal. Seeing a share name does not establish entry; reading a file does not establish modification or deletion rights.

items.title: Transport｜Establish connectivity
items.body:
✓ TCP 445 is reachable
× Does not establish a share listing

items.title: Negotiate｜Agree on the protocol
items.body:
✓ SMB version and capabilities
× Does not establish authentication

items.title: Session Setup｜Establish identity
items.body:
✓ Confirm the identity actually used
× Does not grant access to every share

items.title: Tree Connect｜Connect to a share
items.body:
✓ Training can be entered, for example
× Does not establish every file is readable

items.title: File Operation｜Operate on files/directories
items.body:
✓ Listing, reading, writing, and more
× Verify each operation separately

visual.caption: SMB 列舉｜同一份紀錄，可以下哪些結論？
visual.description: 合成情境：LAB / labreader；只根據真正觀察到的操作判斷。安全判讀：支援（Capability）≠ 要求（Policy）≠ 本次實際使用（Observed）。Signing 保護訊息完整性；Encryption 保護傳輸機密性，兩者都不會增加檔案權限。

visual.caption: SMB enumeration｜Which conclusions does this record support?
visual.description: Synthetic case: LAB / labreader. Judge only operations actually observed. Capability ≠ Policy ≠ Observed use in this connection. Signing protects message integrity; encryption protects confidentiality in transit. Neither grants additional file permissions.
